newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gasoline up $3-$4.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gasoline up $3-$4.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline rose by $3-$4, mainly on the jump in NYMEX levels. August swaps were quoted late at $198-$199, $7 ahead of September, which was in turn seen $5 above October.

Naphtha swaps also jumped late as the early IPE closure forced traders to focus more closely on the rapidly rising NYMEX. The August swap gain on the day was seen at $3-$3.50 to $189-$189.50 as brokers saw notional gains in balanced-to-tight naphtha physical.
August IPE closed at $167.50. Heating oil cargo spreads firmed $1 on supply worries and better demand, trading at a $2 premium to August IPE. Barges were dormant.

High sulphur fuel oil weakened as fresh Russian material appeared on the horizon, traders said. Barges traded between $89 and $91 a tonne fob ARA and sank to the lower end of this range by the afternoon.
